session_note: The 2025-2026 California Legislature is a two-year regular session that convened December 2, 2024 and does not adjourn sine die until November 30, 2026 (final floor votes/chaptering typically run through August-September 2026, with the Governor's last bill-signing deadline in early-to-mid October 2026). As of 2026-07-31 the Legislature is in its scheduled summer recess (mid-July to early August), which is why several bills below show a last action in late June/early July with a committee hearing already calendared for the first week of August 2026. Bills introduced in 2025 that had not passed their house of origin by the constitutional January 31, 2026 deadline (Cal. Const. art. IV, sec. 10(c)) die automatically (e.g., AB1095); bills that already cleared that deadline or were introduced fresh in 2026 remain live for the rest of the biennium and are not 'carried over' in any special procedural sense - they are simply still pending on the normal 2026 calendar.

new_bills.status: Passed Assembly; read second time and amended, re-referred to Senate Appropriations 2026-07-02 (hearing set 2026-08-03)
new_bills.key_provisions: Requires the CPUC to establish, by 2028-01-01, a separate electricity rate class/tariff for data centers so costs are proportional to cost-to-serve; requires large new data center transmission-level service agreements after 2027-01-01 to include minimum 10-year contract terms, prepayment of interconnection costs, and support for clean energy/wildfire mitigation programs; extends comparable requirements to CCAs and ESPs serving data centers.
